newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-SOUTH AFRICA CRUSH INDIA TO KEEP PERFECT RECORD.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SOUTH AFRICA CRUSH INDIA TO KEEP PERFECT RECORD.

text.p: South Africa maintained their 100 percent record in the triangular series with a crushing six wicket victory over India in Port Elizabeth on Sunday.
They comfortably recorded their fifth victory with 4.5 overs to spare after tight bowling and fielding restricted India to 179 for nine.

Man of the match Jacques Kallis led the South African run chase with his highest score in 14 one-day international innings, making 79 from 127 balls before he was caught on the boundary with just 28 required.
India's total of 179 was never enough as they struggled to recover from the loss of Saurav Ganguly in the first over.
By the eighth over they had subsided to 11 for three and it took a fourth wicket partnership of 105 between Mohammad Azharuddin (57) and opener Rahul Dravid (50) to set any kind of a target.
South Africa have already booked their place in the final but India and Zimbabwe have just one point each in the series although the Indians have a game in hand.
